headline: Easier Route
caption:
Brendan Allen says Dricus du Plessis ducked him for Kamaru Usman.
Allen or DDP? 👇

Allen says their January fight fell apart and DDP picked the easier Usman matchup instead, which he won in July. Allen (27-7) headlines UFC Vegas 122 against Christian Leroy Duncan on Saturday in Las Vegas. UFC middleweight news.

Who's right?
question: Allen or DDP?
